subject.title: fix(groq): keep default Llama agent turns within TPM limit

question: Should OpenClaw resolve the Groq TPM bug with this provider/model-scoped recovery, or adopt the competing transport-wide reservation policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104916 instead?
rationale: Both PRs address the same observable failure but intentionally choose incompatible policy boundaries; source-level review cannot safely choose the permanent provider-versus-core behavior without maintainer product and compatibility intent.

options.title: Adopt the scoped Groq recovery
options.body: Keep ordinary requests unchanged and land this PR after accepting its host/provenance compatibility boundary.

options.title: Adopt the transport-wide policy
options.body: Pause this PR and make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104916 the canonical direction if implicit output reservations should change across OpenAI-compatible providers.

options.title: Request a narrower shared seam
options.body: Pause both implementations until maintainers define a reusable explicit-budget provenance contract that avoids provider-specific policy drift.

recommendation.title: Adopt the scoped Groq recovery
recommendation.body: Keep ordinary requests unchanged and land this PR after accepting its host/provenance compatibility boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent commits implement the provenance and fallback boundary that maintainers need to evaluate alongside the competing proposal.
